title: Forge Hub | Auto Sort, Auto Upgrades, Tracking & More
features:
STATUS
- Live progression and library dashboard
- Per genre completion tracker
- Live sorting stats with books per second
- Dynamic completion ETA

AUTO SORT
- Self healing auto sort that completes even a messed up library
- Two sorting styles (finish shelves first or fast clean)
- Adjustable sorting speed
- Genre filter
- Auto respawn books
- Auto stop (at full completion, shelf count or time)
- Return to spawn when finished

PROGRESSION
- Auto upgrades for powerups, magic and the assistant (custom priority)
- Target specific upgrades to level
- Level cap and point reserve
- Quick buy powerups
- Auto ascend at full completion
- Manual ascend

COMPANIONS
- Auto cast magic spells
- Manual spell casting
- Assistant hire (minutes, full match or lifetime)
- Free assistant from an ad
- Pause and resume the assistant

MOVEMENT
- Walk speed (adjustable)
- Jump height (adjustable)
- Infinite jump
- Fly (adjustable speed and keybind)
- Noclip (keybind)

VISUALS
- Book ESP (color by genre, distance and amount limits, genre filter)
- Shelf ESP with completion status
- Highlights the exact shelf each carried book belongs on
- Book finder (search any title, highlight and teleport)
- Shelf finder (browse by genre, highlight and teleport)

UTILITY
- Respawn books
- Teleports (spawn, exit, both floors and every genre)
- Server hop and rejoin
- Anti AFK
- Reset save
- Unload interface

WEBHOOK
- Discord progress tracking
- Shelf and milestone alerts
- Genre completion alerts
- Stat point alerts
- Ascend alerts
- Sort start and stop alerts
- Full stats report (custom interval)
- Ping at full completion
